title: Syracuse Rental Registry
description: The Rental Registry is a Periodic Inspection Program of the Division of Code Enforcement (DOCE). Owners of any one- or two-family non-owner occupied dwellings rented or leased within the City of Syracuse are required to apply for and obtain a Rental Registry Certificate every 3 years. Please note that the data displayed here are limited and may not fully represent all Rental Registry status details. Please refer to the Periodic Inspections Webpage for additional help, and contact the Code Enforcment Office at codeenforcement@syr.gov or 315-448-8695 to: Request an eligible property be added to the program Request application, status, or inspection details If you cannot find the information you’re looking for here Data Dictionary: Label Definition Definition Source PropertyAddress Parcel street number and street address. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) parcel_id Unique parcel identifier. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) ZIP Zip code of parcels street address Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) SBL Stands for Section, Block, Lot. This is a property tax number unique to this property. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) Vacant Y = Determined vacant by the Division of Code Enforcement Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) NeedsRR Whether a parcel is assigned the user defined "Rental Registry Required," this is added to properties that are 1-2 family non-owner occupied Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) transaction_to_property_id Unique number that joins this property to its owner information. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) completion_date The date that the completion type was entered on a Rental Registry case Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) completion_type_name The two completion types associated with the Rental Registry are "Rental Registry Card Issued" and "Family Based Exemption Granted" Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) inpsection_period The date associated with the Rental Registry case (this is updated manually at different periods for different reasons -- it could be the date a new case/inspection period was created, the date of an upcoming scheduled inspection, or the date that the property is coming due to reapply -- may not be hugely useful for the public without access to all of the case details) Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) insp_comp_is_active Whether or not the Rental Registry of any given property is currently valid. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) valid_until The date that the current Rental Registry certificate will expire - this is 3 years from the date that the last completion (RR card or family based exemption) was issued. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) rr_is_valid Whether or not the Rental Registry of any given property is currently valid. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) Latitude Latitude of this parcel. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) Longitude Longitude of this parcel. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) ObjectID Unique identifier, assigned by ArcGIS to the dataset. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) Dataset Contact Information: Organization: City of Syracuse Position: Data Program Manager City: Syracuse, NY E-Mail Address: opendata@syr.gov
